items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Presley? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. I think he swindled him.

ctx.x: No. He passed on a year or two ago. A lot of times... I found out later he swindled a lot of guys. Otis Blackwell, the guy who wrote all them songs for...
Yeah. I think he swindled him. Because I remember when Otis was writing all them tunes.
